name: The Brand Onion Model
diagnostic: How do our daily visual and verbal touchpoints connect directly back to our non-negotiable core values and foundational convictions?
artifact: A Multi-Tiered Behavioral Onion Map: Core Values → Brand Essence → Character & Positioning → External Expressions and Manifestations.
trap: Treating the outer behavioral layer as a styling exercise while leaving the core values too broad to guide real business trade-offs.
pedigreeFull: Consumer Goods Strategy Practice (1990s). A diagnostic system that peels back organizational layers to reveal the enduring core identity beneath external marketing expressions.
